blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – The Department of Migrant Workers (DMW) on Monday welcomed a Supreme Court ruling on a Filipino seafarer’s disability claim, noting that it will help guide the handling of similar cases involving illnesses contracted at sea, including those not listed as occupational diseases.
